title: Implementation of Propeller-Wing Interference Model and Horizontal Tail Analysis into a Viscous Full Potential Flow Solver Framework for Aircraft Design
venue: 35th Congress of the International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS 2026), Sydney

title: Effect of Blade Shape on Aerodynamic and Aeroacoustic Characteristics of Vertical Axis Wind Turbines using Mid-fidelity and High-fidelity Methods
abstract: Straight, troposkein and helical blade configurations compared for Darrieus vertical-axis wind turbines using lifting-line free vortex wake and lattice Boltzmann / very large eddy simulation. Straight blades produce roughly 11% more power; helical designs give smoother force distributions and shift noise to 20-30 Hz, against 500-2000 Hz for straight blades driven by blade-vortex interaction.

title: Computational Analysis on the Effects of Leading Edge Tubercles on the Performance of Rotating Propeller
venue: 34th Congress of the International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences, Florence
abstract: Whether bio-inspired leading-edge tubercles can suppress blade separation and delay transition on a rotating propeller, assessed with RANS CFD and validated against unsteady vorticity panel and lattice Boltzmann solvers plus a purpose-built Cranfield propeller rig.
